verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents scoped API keys that can be limited to a single pod or a single inbox, plus a Permissions feature that restricts what an API key can do. Together these let you issue least-privilege credentials for an agent. Missing for 10: detail on which actions the permission model can grant or deny, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scoped-key behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Scoped API keys restrict access to a single pod or a single inbox.
`Permissions` let you restrict what an API key can do.
create a Pod per customer, give them a scoped API key, and route webhook events to the right place.
